_about: Settings for scripts/bill_outlook.py, the bill outcome model (shared core: scripts/policy_outlook_core.py).
For a tracked bill, the model describes what followed past state laws of the same kind (the passes branch)
and the state's own recent record without the law (the fails branch), each against comparison states over
the same months. It describes resemblance to past records. It is not a probability and claims no cause.
A new bill is one entry under bills. A new precedent is one entry under precedents: it must name the
state_policies rows it rests on, and its date_quote must appear word for word in one of those rows'
summary or amendments_note, so every effective date traces to a source that was read.

contested_blocked_share.label: Share of decided contested projects that were blocked

queue_withdrawn_share.label: Share of interconnection requests closed by withdrawal rather than operation

groups.limits_local: A state law that limits what local governments may do to solar, wind or storage siting (preemption of local rules, caps on local moratoria, state approval in place of local approval).
groups.state_standards: A state law that sets siting standards (setbacks, height, noise) that apply in place of or beside local ones.
groups.expands_local: A state law that gives local governments new power to bar or restrict projects (opt-out or restricted-area laws).
groups.state_ban: A state law that itself bars a technology in some places.
